mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence, model_turn, scheduler_version, next_segment_sequence, state, expected_members, completed_members, recovery_generation, ready_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND plan_generation = #{planGeneration} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND node_attempt = #{nodeAttempt} AND segment_sequence = #{segmentSequence} AND model_turn = #{modelTurn}

SELECT id, run_id, plan_generation, node_id, node_attempt, segment_sequence, model_turn, scheduler_version, next_segment_sequence, state, expected_members, completed_members, recovery_generation, ready_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY member_seq

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND external_operation_id = #{externalOperationId}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, member_seq, member_identity, tool_call_id, tool_name, external_operation_id, state, result_ref_json::text AS result_ref_json, next_poll_at, poll_count, backoff_step, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity}

SELECT id, group_id, run_id, recovery_generation, state, next_visible_at, consumed_at, consumed_by, created_at, updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY recovery_generation

WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.run_control_version FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} AND g.run_id = r.id WHERE r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} FOR UPDATE ), member_done AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = #{memberState}::varchar, result_ref_json = CAST(#{resultRefJson} AS jsonb), external_operation_id = COALESCE(m.external_operation_id, #{externalOperationId}::varchar), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.member_identity = #{memberIdentity} AND (CAST(#{externalOperationId} AS varchar) IS NULL OR m.external_operation_id = CAST(#{externalOperationId} AS varchar)) AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING m.id, m.group_id, m.member_seq, m.state ), group_bumped AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET completed_members = g.completed_members + CASE WHEN #{memberState}::varchar IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM member_done d WHERE g.id = d.group_id AND g.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING g.id, g.completed_members, g.expected_members, g.recovery_generation ), group_ready AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'READY', recovery_generation = g.recovery_generation + 1, ready_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_bumped b WHERE g.id = b.id AND b.completed_members = b.expected_members RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.recovery_generation ), notification_written AS ( INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification (group_id, run_id, recovery_generation, state, next_visible_at) SELECT r.id, r.run_id, r.recovery_generation, 'WAITING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_ready r ON CONFLICT (group_id, recovery_generation) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1 ) SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT id FROM member_done), (SELECT id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity}) ) AS member_id, (SELECT member_seq FROM member_done) AS member_seq, COALESCE( (SELECT state FROM member_done), (SELECT state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity}) ) AS member_state, (SELECT id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) AS group_id, COALESCE( (SELECT 'READY' FROM group_ready), (SELECT state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS group_state, COALESCE( (SELECT completed_members FROM group_bumped), (SELECT completed_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS completed_members, COALESCE( (SELECT expected_members FROM group_bumped), (SELECT expected_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS expected_members, (SELECT recovery_generation FROM group_ready) AS recovery_generation, (SELECT 1 FROM notification_written) AS notification_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM member_done) AS written_members

WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} AND g.run_id = r.id FOR UPDATE OF r ), member_late AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'LATE', result_ref_json = CAST(#{resultRefJson} AS jsonb), external_operation_id = COALESCE(m.external_operation_id, #{externalOperationId}::varchar), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.member_identity = #{memberIdentity} AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING m.id, m.group_id, m.member_seq, m.state ), group_stopped AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM member_late d WHERE g.id = d.group_id AND g.state IN ('WAITING', 'READY') RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.plan_generation, g.node_id, g.node_attempt, g.next_segment_sequence ), segment_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE wi.run_id = s.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = s.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = s.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = s.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = s.next_segment_sequence AND wi.state IN ('WAITING', 'RESUMABLE', 'RUNNABLE') RETURNING 1 ), notification_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE n.group_id = s.id AND n.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT id FROM member_late) AS member_id, (SELECT member_seq FROM member_late) AS member_seq, (SELECT state FROM member_late) AS member_state, (SELECT id FROM group_stopped) AS group_id, COALESCE( (SELECT 'CANCELED' FROM group_stopped), (SELECT state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) ) AS group_state, (SELECT completed_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) AS completed_members, (SELECT expected_members FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group WHERE id = #{groupId}) AS expected_members, NULL::int AS recovery_generation, NULL::int AS notification_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM member_late) AS written_members

WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.plan_generation FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n ON n.run_id = r.id WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.state = 'WAITING' AND n.next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion} FOR UPDATE OF r ), notification_consumed AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, consumed_by = #{dispatcherId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.state = 'WAITING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING n.id, n.group_id, n.run_id ), group_resumed AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'RESUMED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM notification_consumed c WHERE g.id = c.group_id AND g.state = 'READY' RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.plan_generation, g.node_id, g.node_attempt, g.next_segment_sequence ), segment_promoted AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi SET state = 'RESUMABLE', runnable_since = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, next_visible_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_resumed r WHERE wi.run_id = r.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = r.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = r.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = r.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = r.next_segment_sequence AND wi.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING wi.segment_sequence ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM notification_consumed) AS consumed, (SELECT count(*) FROM segment_promoted) AS promoted, (SELECT group_id FROM notification_consumed) AS group_id, (SELECT segment_sequence FROM segment_promoted) AS next_segment_sequence

WITH run_fence AS ( SELECT r.id AS run_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run r JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = #{groupId} AND g.run_id = r.id FOR UPDATE OF r ), group_stopped AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE g.id = #{groupId} AND g.state IN ('WAITING', 'READY') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_fence) RETURNING g.id, g.run_id, g.plan_generation, g.node_id, g.node_attempt, g.next_segment_sequence ), members_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'CANCELED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE m.group_id = s.id AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') RETURNING 1 ), segment_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE wi.run_id = s.run_id AND wi.plan_generation = s.plan_generation AND wi.node_id = s.node_id AND wi.node_attempt = s.node_attempt AND wi.segment_sequence = s.next_segment_sequence AND wi.state IN ('WAITING', 'RESUMABLE', 'RUNNABLE') RETURNING 1 ), notification_canceled AS ( UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM group_stopped s WHERE n.group_id = s.id AND n.state = 'WAITING' RETURNING 1 ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM group_stopped) AS groups_canceled, (SELECT count(*) FROM members_canceled) AS members_canceled, (SELECT count(*) FROM segments_canceled) AS segments_canceled, (SELECT count(*) FROM notification_canceled) AS notifications_canceled
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m SET state = 'RUNNING', external_operation_id = COALESCE(#{externalOperationId}::varchar, m.external_operation_id), next_poll_at = COALESCE(#{nextPollAt}, m.next_poll_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.member_identity = #{memberIdentity} AND m.state = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = m.run_id AND r.status = 'EXECUTING' AND r.run_control_version = #{runControlVersion})

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member SET next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt}, poll_count = poll_count + 1, backoff_step = LEAST(backoff_step + 1, #{maxBackoffStep}::int), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_identity = #{memberIdentity} AND state = 'RUNNING'
